uncertainty.unit: 18 whole task blocks; all four fixed models and three variants remain paired. Models have equal weight within tasks; tasks have equal weight.
uncertainty.dispersion: Sample SD (ddof=1), median, Q1/Q3 and IQR, computed separately across response scores, task means, paired model-task cells and paired task means.
uncertainty.finite_benchmark: All selected original scores observed; intervals measure empirical task-composition sensitivity, not population confidence or scoring/generation uncertainty.
uncertainty.by_task: Show the four fixed-model values; no inferential interval with four models.
